name: 16AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - 5ft roll
title: 16AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - 5ft roll
description:
The 16AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - 5ft roll is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, the products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings Nylon and Stainless-steel Braided AN Hose is universally compatible. Common uses include motor oil, gas, E85, race-fuel, and coolant. For more detail about ColorFittings AN Hose, refer here.

The 16AN diameter Nylon & Stainless-steel braided AN Hose operates at a 350PSI threshold, and boasts a 1400PSI burst threshold.

For a hassle-free installation process, Color-Fittings strongly recommend using the Fitting Assembly Tools.

the Nylon & Stainless-steel braided AN Hose pairs excellently with the lightweight Hose Separators, which are available in unique gloss-finish colors.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
